'''Dingfeng''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]]. Appears in morning next to [[Chanxue]] in front of City Hall.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Dingfeng:''' Who gets scared of someone they have no connection with? It's absurd, haha.
:'''Chanxue:''' I'm still here!
:'''Dingfeng:''' Hahaha, I didn't say who it was.
:'''Chanxue:''' I...
:'''Dingfeng:''' It's fine, I've known [[Sanhua]] for a while. She might seem icy, but there's no need to worry.
{{Dialogue End}}
